treatment_summary.value: Colchicine, 5-aminosalicylic acid, surgical placement of setons (Table 1); setons were placed to drain each fistula and seton drainages were required for 1 year after their placement.

disease_label_as_stated.value: infantile-onset HA20 with a severe perianal lesion (infantile-onset IBD)

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Whole-exome sequencing with CNV analysis of WES data (EXCAVATOR2) and genome-wide SNP array (Infinium Asian Screening Array-24 v1.0) showing a de novo 119 kb microdeletion involving only TNFAIP3; no homozygous IL10/IL10R variants. Oral aphthous ulcers, arthritis and intestinal punched-out ulcers did not fulfill criteria for complete or incomplete Behçet disease.

parental_testing_statement.value: DNA was extracted from the peripheral blood leukocytes of the patient, her parents, and her grandparents. Patient homozygous (A/A) for TNFAIP3 c.305A > G (NM_001270507.2); mother (II-2) heterozygous (A/G); father (II-1) homozygous for the reference allele (G/G), suggesting a deletion. CNV analysis of WES data (EXCAVATOR2) showed a single de novo 187 kb microdeletion within TNFAIP3; genome-wide SNP array of the patient and her father validated a de novo 119 kb microdeletion; only the patient harbored the 119 kb deletion. Both WES and CNV analyses indicated that the patient had lost the paternal allele of the TNFAIP3 gene.
